text:
liam: quick sanity check — bringing up orse-v2-int8 on staging and seeing weird non-monotonic behavior between clustering metrics and recall@k. kmeans silhouette dropped from 0.41 -> 0.28 but recall@10 only drops for short queries. anyone seen this pattern before?
maria: hmm that mismatch usually smells like local density collapse for short queries. do you have a small repro set?
liam: yes smallset-1 (2k queries, median len 8 tokens). ran full-precision baseline earlier: recall@10 = 0.78, silhouette = 0.42. int8 run: recall@10 = 0.64, silhouette = 0.29.
alex: ouch. what's the quantization path? per-channel or per-tensor?
liam: per-tensor symmetric, straight PTQ from ONNX export. no clamp tuning. batch_size=32 for eval.
raj: try per-channel or dynamic clamp — short queries often hit outlier heads and cause directional shrink. also check L2 norm distribution shift.
maria: can you paste eval-bot summary? would help to see recall by length buckets. :eyes: 
eval-bot: summary for thread 3742009999:
```
model: orse-v2-int8 (onnx ptq)
dataset: smallset-1 (2k)
metrics:
  recall@1: fp=0.52 -> int8=0.39
  recall@10: fp=0.78 -> int8=0.64
  silhouette: fp=0.42 -> int8=0.29
  avg-l2: fp=1.12 -> int8=0.78
  short-query (<=10 tokens) recall@10: fp=0.81 -> int8=0.55
  long-query (>50 tokens) recall@10: fp=0.74 -> int8=0.72
notes: short-query degradation dominates. norm compression observed.
```
maria: thanks — avg-l2 drop confirms norm compression. could be activation range mismatch during PTQ.
liam: quick tests: re-ran with batch_size=8 and per-channel enabled, same seeds. recall@10 for short queries improved from 0.55 -> 0.68, silhouette 0.29 -> 0.36.
alex: promising. that points to calibration noise from large eval batches + per-tensor scale. low-batch calibration can under-estimate ranges for rare activations.
raj: next steps: 1) switch to per-channel quant + clamp (calib with 256 random samples), 2) run kmeans stability sweep (k in 50..150), 3) add prefix KV-cache-aware quant tests for long context.
liam: created PR with initial per-channel calibration changes: https://git.redwood/orse/PR-2147 — added calib samples and batch_size tweak. can someone ack?
maria: taking a look now. if per-channel fixes most short-query drop, we should add a short-query holdout to the onboard checklist and a quick silhouette check.
alex: agree. also add a small whitening pre-step option to the eval harness to see if centering helps. sometimes mean-shift after quant makes centroids weird.
liam: noted. I'll add holdout and whitening toggle to the harness. thanks y'all. :thumbsup: 
raj: if tests look good we'll promote to dedicated-staging and run 24h synthetic traffic to surface tail cases.
liam: plan sounds good. will update thread with new eval-bot run once PR merges.
eval-bot: queued new run on orse-v2-int8 (per-channel calib) — expect results in ~12m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
